capabilities: follow the active page and restore its most recent conversation
run Codex agent conversations with streaming, tool status, and approvals
mention other notes with @ and attach local files as context
keep agent tasks running in the background across page switches
select models and reasoning effort per conversation or as defaults
extras: YOLO mode disables approval prompts and gives Codex unrestricted local execution; the README warns to leave it off in untrusted environments. First public beta targets macOS desktop and a single vault. Also available via BRAT or manual installation.
motivation: The author built it to make agent-assisted work feel native and nearly invisible, reducing interaction to one action: opening the page you want to work on.
problem: Chat-centric agent plugins live in a persistent sidebar with tab-managed conversations, so users must manually keep note navigation and chat navigation in sync.

relations.evidence: imports a selected snapshot of Claudian's provider-neutral runtime contracts and Codex adapter
Windy launches codex app-server as a local child process
